# Alert when /data is almost full (availability < 10%)
alert: DataDiskAlmostFull
expr: (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/data"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/data"})) > 0.9
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Data disk almost full on {{ $labels.instance }}"
  description: "The /data mountpoint is almost full (usage > 90%). Current usage: {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} on instance {{ $labels.instance }}."
```

| Part | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `expr` | `node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/data"}` divides available bytes by total size for the `/data` mountpoint. `1 - ...` computes usage. The expression fires when usage **> 0.9** (i.e., availability < 0.1 / 10%). |
| `for: 5m` | The condition must persist for **5 minutes** before the alert fires. |
| `labels` | Assigns a `severity` label (you can adjust as needed). |
| `annotations` | Provides a human-readable `summary` and `description` that include the current usage percentage and the instance name. |
